name: Orloj: The Prague Astronomical Clock

categories.label: Victory Points on score track
categories.hint: Score marker total from in-play scoring (add 100 if the marker is flipped).

categories.label: Mastery window 1
categories.hint: Needs experience marker on space 7. Primary value (highest marker; ties all get it) or secondary value (past brick line) x conditions met; values printed on the window.

categories.label: Gold tokens after exchange
categories.hint: Trade all resources/coins at 3 identical resources = 1 gold (coin = wild); 1 VP per gold.

categories.label: Broken-gear deviations
categories.hint: -1 VP per broken-gear icon still visible on your deviation tokens.

categories.label: Assistants on workshop cards
categories.hint: Sum of end-game bonuses of assistants placed on workshop cards (6 VP; 1 per upgrade level; 4 per skill marker at IV; 5 per full apostle column; 3 per lunar circle / zodiac with your worker).

categories.label: Common goal windows
categories.hint: By worker order on each common-goal window: 1st 8 VP, 2nd 6 VP, 3rd 4 VP. Enter the total over the three windows.

categories.label: Apostles on panel (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Số tông đồ trên bảng (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Count apostles placed on your apostle panel.

tiebreakers.description: Most apostles on the player panel; if still tied the victory is shared

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Source is the official Czech rulebook (Bohemian Games, sections 11-12 and overview p.22); English rulebook on BGG could not be downloaded. Mastery window values are printed on the stained glass (random set of three per game), so enter each window as a subtotal; see rulebook 12.1. Game ends after the round in which the last calendar circle is built or the 4th rooster crow. Solo (Josef Manes) variant not modelled.
